role_policy: Model is shared only between prompt-voice-disjoint development and acceptance; no Parler voices/output used in wake-model training. Same generator parent is a disclosed correlation, not proof of physical-speaker independence. This explicitly differs from old v1 mechanical auditor that rejects shared TTS weight hashes across roles; do not claim that auditor passed.
training_exclusion: All288 requests excluded from wake-model training; acceptance requests remain ungenerated/unopened until candidate/threshold/protocol frozen and development passes.

candidate.policy: One candidate fixed before any new development scores; current Mac trial identity. Frozen v30 and official HiESP are reference models, not alternative candidates chosen after scores.

required_before_generation: Pinned bytes/runtime and complete greedy generator hash in separately pushed execution lock
Complete generator implementation saves full native float32 NPY before full-vector resampling; stop on generation limit/truncation or quality failure
Existing consumed-name history query completion with scope limits retained; do not infer physical-speaker disjointness
Development-only launch; no acceptance generation in development execution
augmentation: After native quality passes, fixed quiet/noise/RIR variants using complete source and full RIR tail, existing audited transport. Actual noise/RIR identities and seed bound before rendering; not yet execution-ready.
background: Existing prospective VoxConverse role plan remains separate, unscored; qualify actual development duration/duplicates before threshold execution.
status: Concrete requests and candidate frozen prospectively; not generation/scoring execution lock or independent acceptance qualification.

changed_source_policy.hypothesis: Replacing stochastic autoregressive sampling with greedy decoding may reduce runaway duration for short text; unproven until entire fixed development pack passes. This is a complete new source protocol, not replacement of one failed draw. No detector scores have been obtained on either pack.
changed_source_policy.unchanged: Weights, voices, texts, descriptions, native/transport formats, 0.2..5s quality gate, EOS/token cap and stop-pack failure policy. Full original failure preserved. No successful-output pooling across protocols.
changed_source_policy.development_reuse: Jon/Lea remain development only. Reusing development requests for a preregistered source-quality experiment is disclosed; it is not new independent acceptance.
changed_source_policy.acceptance_policy: Gary/Jenna remain ungenerated. Only this complete protocol may be evaluated if development passes; no acceptance-based decoder choice.
